data.description:
## Testing Mode: RED

Write failing tests in `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_arbiter_dispatch.py` covering the DISPATCH_ARBITER branch of runner.main() — arbiter dispatch, process_rulings wiring, and arbiter PR comment posting. Routing tests (PASS/DISPATCH_NEXT/SHORT_CIRCUIT) are scoped to task 7712.

## Story DD Coverage
- DD5: Arbiter dispatch step bundles inputs (findings + defenses + diff + cycle metadata + reviewer_breakdown + ledger_history) and calls `dispatch_cycle_end_arbiter`.
- DD6: `arbiter_processor.process_rulings(rulings, finding_map, ...)` is called with sidecar write + DEFER tickets + DROP defenses.
- DD7: arbiter PR comment posted with marker `DSO-Arbiter-Ruling: cycle=K commit_sha=<sha>`, idempotent.
- DD8 (partial): exit 0 if no BLOCK in arbiter rulings; non-zero if any BLOCK.

## Specific failing test method names

1. `test_dispatch_arbiter_calls_dispatch_cycle_end_arbiter_with_full_bundle` — assert dispatch_cycle_end_arbiter called with findings, defenses, diff_text, model, provider_chain, cycle_num, max_cycles, reviewer_breakdown, ledger_history args.
2. `test_dispatch_arbiter_calls_process_rulings_with_aligned_finding_map` — assert finding_map = {i: f for i, f in enumerate(findings_passed_to_arbiter)}. Reorder/filter between calls must cause `skipped_invalid_index` to fire (regression guard).
3. `test_dispatch_arbiter_block_ruling_exits_one` — arbiter returns [{ruling:'BLOCK', finding_index:0, ...}]; assert main() returns 1.
4. `test_dispatch_arbiter_no_block_exits_zero` — arbiter returns only DROP/DEFER rulings; assert main() returns 0.
5. `test_post_arbiter_comment_creates_with_marker` — assert comment body contains literal substring `DSO-Arbiter-Ruling: cycle=K commit_sha=<sha>` (K and sha substituted).
6. `test_post_arbiter_comment_updates_existing` — pre-seed PR comments with matching marker (same cycle + commit_sha); assert UPDATE call (gh api PATCH /repos/.../comments/<id>), not duplicate CREATE.
7. `test_post_arbiter_comment_skips_when_no_pr` — PR_NUMBER unset; assert no gh calls.

## Behavioral assertions

Mock `dispatch_cycle_end_arbiter`, `process_rulings`, and `subprocess.run` (gh CLI). Assert OBSERVABLE outcomes (function call arguments, exit codes, PR comment body content). NO assertions on internal call order beyond what is semantically required.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] All 7 tests added in test_runner_arbiter_dispatch.py
  Verify: cd plugins/dso && python3 -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_arbiter_dispatch.py -q --co | grep -E 'test_(dispatch_arbiter|post_arbiter_comment)' | wc -l   # expect 7
- [ ] All 7 tests fail with messages referencing missing symbols `_post_arbiter_comment` / `_build_reviewer_breakdown` / `_read_prior_arbiter_rulings` (or AttributeError when patching them on runner module)
  Verify: cd plugins/dso && python3 -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_arbiter_dispatch.py -q 2>&1 | grep -E '(FAILED|ERROR)' | wc -l   # expect 7 or more
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_arbiter_dispatch.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_arbiter_dispatch.py

## File Impact
- tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_arbiter_dispatch.py (new, ~250 lines)
